candidate_workaround: Expand the bounded test file list with Get-ChildItem, then search each exact LiteralPath for test methods.
failure_signature: A read-only ripgrep command received an unexpanded Windows wildcard path and exited nonzero before counting source-phase tests.
recurrence_guard: Never pass a Windows wildcard as a literal ripgrep path; enumerate the bounded files first and pass exact paths.
rollback: Give the wildcard probe zero discovery credit, retain its error, and do not broaden test selection to compensate.
scope_boundary: Read-only bounded test discovery only; no full repository suite, scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Enumerate exact Windows test paths before discovery
trigger_preconditions: A bounded test selection spans more than one Windows filename.
